title: NarrativeTrace Entry
description: Atomic trace event emitted by the NarrativeTrace library on method entry, exit, fork, or join. Layer 1 (universal) + Layer 2 (OTel) + Layer 3 (NarrativeTrace extensions).

level.description: Log level. method_enter/method_exit = trace, errors = warn/error.

message.description: Human-readable summary. e.g., '→ OrderService.placeOrder(customerId: C1)' or '!! PaymentDeclinedException: Card expired'.

service.description: Service name. Maps to OTel resource attribute service.name.

version.description: Service version. Maps to OTel resource attribute service.version.

host.name.description: OTel semantic convention. Auto-detected host name; absent when narrativetrace.capture.resource is disabled. Added in 1.2.

process.pid.description: OTel semantic convention. Process id; absent when resource capture is disabled. Added in 1.2.

process.runtime.version.description: OTel semantic convention. Java runtime version; absent when resource capture is disabled. Added in 1.2.

trace_id.description: W3C trace ID. 32 lowercase hex characters.

span_id.description: W3C span ID. 16 lowercase hex characters.

parent_span_id.description: Parent span ID. Null for root spans.

code.namespace.description: OTel semantic convention. Class or module name (e.g., 'OrderService').

code.function.description: OTel semantic convention. Method or function name (e.g., 'placeOrder').

code.filepath.description: OTel semantic convention. Source file of the entry; absent unless narrativetrace.capture.sourceLocation is enabled. Agent records the declaration site, proxy the call site. Added in 1.2.

code.lineno.description: OTel semantic convention. 1-based line number matching code.filepath. Added in 1.2.

exception.type.description: OTel semantic convention. Exception class name when outcome is error.

exception.message.description: OTel semantic convention. Exception message when outcome is error.

thread.name.description: OTel semantic convention. Name of the thread that executed the entry. Added in 1.2.

thread.id.description: OTel semantic convention. Numeric id of the thread that executed the entry. Added in 1.2.

durationMs.description: Method duration in milliseconds. Present on exit events.

nt.entryType.description: Discriminator. Always 'entry' for atomic events. See chapter.schema.json for chapters.

nt.eventType.description: Event type within the trace lifecycle.

nt.chapterId.description: Chapter this entry belongs to. Generated by the library per service per request.

nt.storyId.description: Story ID. Typically derived from trace_id.

nt.causalId.description: Causal chain identifier. Survives thread/async boundaries for causality tracking.

nt.forkId.description: Fork group identifier. Present on fork/join events for concurrent branch correlation.

nt.branchIndex.description: Branch index within a fork group. Identifies which concurrent branch this entry belongs to.

nt.outcome.description: Outcome of the method call. Present on exit events.

nt.traceName.description: Human-readable 3-word name derived from trace_id (e.g., 'bold elk soars'). Cross-platform deterministic.

nt.schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Allows backward-compatible evolution. 1.1 added nt.narrationTemplate; 1.2 added the additive nullable identity fields nt.package, nt.exceptionPackage, nt.returnType, the type property on nt.parameters items, thread identity (thread.name, thread.id, nt.threadVirtual), and process resource identity (host.name, process.pid, process.runtime.version).

nt.threadVirtual.description: Whether the entry ran on a virtual thread. Null when thread identity was not captured. Added in 1.2.

nt.instanceId.description: Identity hash of the receiver object in lowercase hex. Absent unless narrativetrace.capture.instanceIds is enabled. Added in 1.2.

nt.returnType.description: Declared return type in Class.getTypeName() form (e.g. 'java.lang.String', 'void', 'long[]'). With parameter types this makes overloads distinguishable. Added in 1.2.

nt.package.description: Package of the declaring type behind code.namespace (e.g. 'com.acme.billing'). code.namespace stays a simple name for readability; this field completes the identity. Added in 1.2.

nt.exceptionPackage.description: Package of the exception class behind exception.type. exception.type stays a simple name; this field completes the identity. Added in 1.2.

nt.narrationTemplate.description: Raw @Narrated template with placeholders intact (e.g. 'Opening for {customerId}'), when an annotation was present. Added in 1.1 so translated views can render per-locale template variants and fill placeholders from untouched values.

value.description: Serialized parameter value. May be '[REDACTED]' for sensitive fields.

redacted.description: True if value was redacted by @NotTraced or equivalent.

type.description: Declared parameter type in Class.getTypeName() form. Added in 1.2.

nt.parameters.description: Method parameters. Present on method_enter events.

nt.returnValue.description: Serialized return value. Present on method_exit events with success outcome.
